name: Emergency / SOS Hand Sign
cue: Raised palm or SOS Sign (tuck thumb, trap thumb)
howTo: Hold open palm facing camera, or perform the Universal SOS sign: palm out, tuck thumb in, and fold fingers over the thumb.
en: Please help / Emergency.
hi: कृपया मदद करें। आपातकाल!

name: Severe Pain
howTo: Squeeze both eyes shut firmly or clutch chest/forehead.
en: I am in severe pain.
hi: मुझे बहुत तेज दर्द हो रहा है।

name: Call Doctor
howTo: Wave hand toward camera beckoning or point index finger forward.
en: Call the doctor immediately.
hi: डॉक्टर को तुरंत बुलाइए।

name: Call Nurse
howTo: Tap fingertips repeatedly against your shoulder or upper chest.
en: Please call the nurse.
hi: कृपया नर्स को बुलाइए।

name: Need Medicine
cue: Thumb to mouth / pill swallowing gesture
howTo: Pinch thumb and forefinger together and touch lips like taking a pill.
en: I need my medicine / pills.
hi: मुझे मेरी दवाई चाहिए।

name: Difficulty Breathing
howTo: Bring one or both hands to your throat or chest with open mouth.
en: I am having trouble breathing.
hi: मुझे सांस लेने में तकलीफ हो रही है।

name: Dizziness / Fainting
howTo: Make a small slow circle with index finger near temple or forehead.
en: I am feeling dizzy / faint.
hi: मुझे चक्कर आ रहे हैं।

name: Injury / Bleeding
howTo: Point one finger emphatically at arm, leg, or bandages.
en: I am hurt or bleeding here.
hi: मुझे यहाँ चोट लगी है।

name: Water
howTo: Form a cup or tilt thumb toward mouth as if drinking water.
en: I need drinking water.
hi: मुझे पीने का पानी चाहिए।

name: Food / Hunger
howTo: Place flat palm over stomach or pat belly gently.
en: I am hungry, I need food.
hi: मुझे भूख लगी है, खाना चाहिए।

name: Washroom / Toilet
howTo: Make a loose fist with thumb between fingers and shake gently.
en: I need to use the washroom / toilet.
hi: मुझे शौचालय / वाशरूम जाना है।

name: Sleep / Tired
cue: Palms pressed on side of cheek
howTo: Rest side of tilted head on flat palm with eyes closed.
en: I want to sleep, I am tired.
hi: मुझे सोना है, मैं थक गया हूँ।
or: ମୁଁ ଶୋଇବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଛି, ମୋତେ ନିଦ ଲାଗୁଛି।

name: Feeling Cold
howTo: Cross arms across chest and rub upper arms as if shivering.
en: I am feeling very cold.
hi: मुझे बहुत ठंड लग रही है।

name: Feeling Hot
howTo: Wave open palm rapidly back and forth in front of face.
en: I am feeling too hot / sweating.
hi: मुझे बहुत गर्मी लग रही है।

name: Bath / Sponge Wash
howTo: Rub closed fists over chest in upward wiping motions.
en: I need a bath or sponge wash.
hi: मुझे नहाना है / स्पंज वाश चाहिए।
or: ମୋତେ ଗାଧୋଇବାକୁ କିମ୍ବା ସଫା ହେବାକୁ ଅଛି।

name: Change Clothes
howTo: Pinch shirt collar between thumb and forefinger and tug lightly.
en: Please change my clothes.
hi: कृपया मेरे कपड़े बदल दीजिए।

name: Need Blanket
cue: Pulling imaginary sheet up to neck
howTo: Grasp with two hands in front of chest and pull upwards toward chin.
en: Please cover me with a blanket.
hi: कृपया मुझे चादर / कंबल ओढ़ा दीजिए।

name: Adjust Pillow
howTo: Pat open hands behind the back of your neck/head.
en: Please adjust or fluff my pillow.
hi: कृपया मेरा तकिया ठीक कर दीजिए।

name: Help Me Sit Up
cue: Flat palm tilting from flat to upright
howTo: Hold hand horizontal then tilt palm upright vertically.
en: Please help me sit up.
hi: कृपया मुझे बैठने में मदद करें।

name: Help Me Lie Down
howTo: Press flat palm gently downward toward lap.
en: Please help me lie down flat.
hi: कृपया मुझे लिटा दीजिए।

name: Turn to Side
cue: Rolling wrists in a flip motion
howTo: Rotate hand palm-up to palm-down repeatedly.
en: Please turn me onto my other side.
hi: कृपया मेरी करवट बदल दीजिए।

name: Stand Up
cue: Two fingers pointing down on open palm
howTo: Point index and middle finger downward like legs walking.
en: I want to try standing up.
hi: मैं खड़ा होना चाहता हूँ।

name: Need Wheelchair
howTo: Hold two fists at chest and rotate them like turning wheelchair wheels.
en: Please bring my wheelchair.
hi: कृपया व्हीलचेयर ले आइए।

name: Want to Walk
howTo: Alternate stepping motion with index and middle fingers.
en: I want to walk / stretch my legs.
hi: मुझे थोड़ा टहलना है।

name: Muscle Cramp
howTo: Grasp your forearm or thigh tightly with the opposite hand.
en: I have a painful muscle cramp.
hi: मेरी नस खिंच गई है / क्रैम्प आ गया है।
or: ମୋ ଗୋଡ଼ କିମ୍ବା ହାତରେ କ୍ରାମ୍ପ / ରକ୍ତ ଜମାଟ ହୋଇଛି।

name: Itching / Scratch
howTo: Scratch back of wrist or arm with fingernails.
en: I have an itch, please scratch it.
hi: मुझे खुजली हो रही है, कृपया खुजा दीजिए।
or: ମୋତେ କୁଣ୍ଡେଇ ହେଉଛି, ଦୟାକରି କୁଣ୍ଡାଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

name: Turn On Light
howTo: Hold pinched fingers upward and open all fingers wide like a light bulb.
en: Please turn on the room light.
hi: कृपया कमरे की लाइट जला दीजिए।

name: Turn Off Light
howTo: Hold open hand up and close all fingers into a tight fist.
en: Please turn off the room light.
hi: कृपया लाइट बंद कर दीजिए।

name: Open Window
howTo: Place both hands side by side and push them outward apart.
en: Please open the window / door.
hi: कृपया खिड़की या दरवाजा खोल दीजिए।

name: Close Window
howTo: Bring both open palms from outside inward until touching.
en: Please close the window / door.
hi: कृपया खिड़की या दरवाजा बंद कर दीजिए।
or: ଦୟାକରି ଝରକା କିମ୍ବା କବାଟ ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ।

name: Fan / AC On
howTo: Point index finger straight up at ceiling and swirl in a circle.
en: Please switch on the fan / AC.
hi: कृपया पंखा या एसी चला दीजिए।

name: Fan / AC Off
howTo: Point up then slash hand flat down horizontally.
en: Please switch off the fan / AC.
hi: कृपया पंखा या एसी बंद कर दीजिए।
or: ଦୟାକରି ପଙ୍ଖା କିମ୍ବା ଏସି ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ।

name: Silence / Too Loud
cue: Index finger placed vertically over lips
howTo: Press index finger upright against closed lips (shh sign).
en: Please be quiet, it is too loud.
hi: कृपया शांत रहें, बहुत शोर है।
or: ଦୟାକରି ଶାନ୍ତ ରୁହନ୍ତୁ, ବହୁତ ଶବ୍ଦ ହେଉଛି।

name: Adjust Bed
howTo: Angle forearm at 45 degrees and bob hand up and down.
en: Please adjust the hospital bed angle.
hi: कृपया बेड का एंगल ठीक कर दीजिए।
or: ଦୟାକରି ଡାକ୍ତରଖାନା ବିଛଣାର କୋଣ ଠିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

name: Yes / Affirmation
cue: Thumbs up or clear head nod
howTo: Extend thumb upright clearly facing camera or nod head forward.
en: Yes, I agree.
hi: हाँ, मैं सहमत हूँ।

name: No / Disagreement
cue: Index finger wagging or head shake
howTo: Raise single index finger and shake it side to side.
en: No, I do not want this.
hi: नहीं, मुझे यह नहीं चाहिए।

name: Thank You
howTo: Press both palms together at chest level in Anjali Mudra.
en: Thank you very much.
hi: आपका बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद।

name: Please / Request
howTo: Rub open palm in a gentle circle over chest.
en: Please, I request you.
hi: कृपया, मैं आपसे निवेदन करता हूँ।

name: I Love You
cue: I-L-Y hand sign / crossed arms over heart
howTo: Hold thumb, index, and pinky upright (ASL I Love You).
en: I love you / affection.
hi: मैं आपसे बहुत प्यार करता हूँ।

name: Scared / Anxious
howTo: Hold two open hands near collarbone with wide eyes.
en: I am feeling scared and anxious.
hi: मुझे डर और घबराहट लग रही है।

name: Sad / Crying
howTo: Draw index finger downward from eye along cheek like a tear.
en: I am feeling sad.
hi: मुझे बहुत उदासी लग रही है।

name: Happy / Good
howTo: Make a V/peace sign near face with a visible smile.
en: I am feeling happy and good.
hi: मैं बहुत खुश हूँ, सब ठीक है।
or: ମୁଁ ଖୁସି ଅଛି, ସବୁ ଠିକ୍ ଅଛି।

name: Call Family
cue: Holding open palm outward with five fingers
howTo: Hold five fingers open and tap over heart.
en: Please call my family members.
hi: कृपया मेरे परिवार को बुलाइए।

name: Phone / Video Call
cue: Thumb and pinky to ear (phone sign)
howTo: Extend thumb and pinky, holding thumb to ear and pinky to mouth.
en: I want to make a phone or video call.
hi: मुझे फोन या वीडियो कॉल करना है।
or: ମୁଁ ଫୋନ୍ କଲ୍ କିମ୍ବା ଭିଡିଓ କଲ୍ କରିବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଛି।

name: Need Spectacles
howTo: Make two circles with thumb and index fingers and hold over eyes like glasses.
en: Please give me my spectacles / glasses.
hi: कृपया मेरा चश्मा दीजिए।

name: Book / Newspaper
cue: Two open palms together like a book
howTo: Join hands side by side palms up, mimicking an open book.
en: I want to read a book or newspaper.
hi: मुझे अखबार या किताब पढ़नी है।
or: ମୁଁ ବହି କିମ୍ବା ଖବରକାଗଜ ପଢ଼ିବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଛି।

name: Turn On TV
howTo: Aim fist with thumb or index clicking like a TV remote controller.
en: Please turn on the TV or music.
hi: कृपया टीवी या संगीत चालू कर दीजिए।

name: Pen and Paper
howTo: Hold imaginary pen in right hand and write on left flat palm.
en: Please give me a pen and paper to write.
hi: मुझे लिखने के लिए कलम और कागज दीजिए।
or: ମୋତେ ଲେଖିବା ପାଇଁ କଲମ ଏବଂ କାଗଜ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

name: Please Wait
howTo: Hold open hand up, palm forward, pulsing gently: wait a moment.
en: Please wait a moment.
hi: कृपया एक क्षण रुकिए / प्रतीक्षा करें।

name: I Understand
cue: Index finger tapping temple then nodding
howTo: Touch side of forehead with index finger and nod head once.
en: I understand clearly.
hi: मैं पूरी तरह समझ गया हूँ।
